source.how: See fixtures/README.md. Every public key and path agrees between an independent from-scratch Python derivation and the rs-platform-wallet-ffi entry points SwiftDashSDK calls; keys 0-3 also take key type, purpose and security level from that FFI. The DashPay pair's metadata comes from reading the Swift source.
